text: Site blockers just ban YouTube, which sucks since half of us learn there. This is Goal Goose.
Oh, and he's very pettable. He dances when you're focused, and naps when you don't need him.
First, you give the goose your goal. Gemini 4 Neon reads it once so it knows what counts as on track and where to send you back.
Every page gets checked against your goal by Decision 1, so a linear algebra lecture on YouTube is totally fine.
If I wander to a cat video, the goose notices. Hydrogen writes the warnings, pushing harder each time.
Before eating anything, the goose's manager has to okay it. Decision 1 and Neon check it's really a distraction and make sure you won't lose your work.
Manager approves, so the goose eats the video and sends you back to the lecture you were watching.
That's Goal Goose. We built it today with Gemini 4.
